workloadDefinitionRule: A performance contract without a representative, versioned workload definition is unverifiable and does not count as a contract.
observationRecordRule: Production observation after deployment is required evidence, not optional monitoring. Absence of an observation record blocks Stable status.
stableApprovalRule: STABLE status requires explicit human approval (approval class STABLE_STATUS) and cannot be inferred from elapsed time without incident.
deploymentEvidenceRule: Every deployment produces a deployment record linking the release readiness record, the artifact version deployed, and the environment.
rollbackRule: Deployment evidence is incomplete without a verified recovery/rollback procedure per paf.recovery.schema.json. An untested recovery is not a recovery.
